detailed_description:
The target video is in a cinematic ultra-realistic contemporary African mining drama, documentary-grade natural light mixed with hard sources, true skin texture with sweat and fine dust, real cloth physics on worn cotton, red laterite dust in the air, high dynamic range style. [Shot 1] the shot follows the viewpoint and subject placement of <Picture 1>; the subject is the same two people throughout, the young man in the faded pale-blue shirt and the older woman with grey at her temples. The camera holds a static shot. His eyes travel up from her face to the grey at her temple and hold there; his throat moves once. The speaker (S1) says, low and quiet, <d>[Chinese] 妈，我不累，</d> the ambient drops away, only faint wind. His right hand lifts toward her hands on the strap and stops in the air a few centimetres short, then lowers back to his side; his gaze slides down and settles on her hands. The speaker (S1) says, the voice thinning out on the last words, <d>[Chinese] 你怎么瘦了这么多。</d>

overall_soundscape:
